verdict.rationale: First-party docs say React can be added to an existing HTML page or stack, rendering components anywhere without a rewrite, mounted via createRoot on any DOM node. The README says you can 'use as little or as much React as you need'. The docs also describe scaling up to full applications through full-stack frameworks like Next.js or React Router. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the incremental-adoption path; all evidence is vendor-claimed.
